<![CDATA[SELECT account.SEGMENT_VALUE1,account.SEGMENT_VALUE2,account.SEGMENT_VALUE3,account.SEGMENT_VALUE4,account.SEGMENT_VALUE5,account.SEGMENT_VALUE6,account.SEGMENT_VALUE7,account.SEGMENT_VALUE8,account.SEGMENT_VALUE9
      
  ,balances.period_name,
        c_budget.name AS budget_name,
        c_budget.control_level_code,
       balances.funds_available_amount
    FROM
        xcc_budget_accounts account,
        xcc_balances_v balances,
        xcc_control_budgets c_budget
  
WHERE
        balances.budget_ccid = account.budget_code_combination_id
        AND balances.control_budget_id = c_budget.control_budget_id
        AND c_budget.status_code = 'IN_USE'
        AND account.segment_value5 in (2104301,2104302,2104303,2215101,2215102,2215103,2215104,2215105,2215106,2215201,2215202,2215203,2215204,2215205,2215208,2215209,2215210,2215211,2215212)
and balances.period_name like '%26%'
--and  c_budget.control_level_code in ('ABSOLUTE','ADVISORY')
]]>
